reviews.title: Unprofessional & inferior service response
reviews.text: I bought an air ticket from Singapore to Yangon on 24 Mar 2023. There were four emails with two different booking reference sent by Mai Air & their payment counterpart to me on 24 Mar 2023, between 1212hrs to 1428hrs. The option cancellation email was the last one that came in on 24 Mar 2023, 1428hrs. As a consumer, I am confused with the content, booking ID difference etc. Hence, I had wrote to Mai Air on 24 Mar 2023, 1545hrs & 1811hrs respectively to clarify (not to assume) on this matter. The flight departure date was on 28 Mar 2023. There was no response from Mai Air from 24 Mar 2023 to 29 Mar 2023, Mai Air first response came on 30 Mar 2023 two days after the flight departure date. When I demand for refund, Mai Air simply use the term & condition of the air ticket upon me. The confusion, slow email response and lack of clarity were never part of their mistake. Re-CONSIDER & think TWICE!!! If you want to buy air ticket from Mai Air.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: The airline was comfortable. We had an early morning flight and breakfast was provided in a paper container and surprisingly good. The airplane was clean and comfortable. Although not directly related to this review about the airline, there are some important information about airports in Myanmar I would like to share. Myanmar airports in general are very chaotic. Although delays are for local flights are extremely common (unless you are on the first flight out in the morning) it is still better to arrive slightly early. Except for the international terminal in Yangon airport which is similar to most other worldwide airports, the local airports are considerably smaller. The waiting rooms at local airports are extremely crowded. Airport food is ridiculously expensive. An ice-cream cone in one local airport costs US $5! Most important of all, there are NO OVERHEAD BOARD DISPLAY showing flight departures. All you get is someone walking into the crowded waiting room holding a sign showing the airline that is boarding at the moment. Then all the passengers rush forward to squeeze through the small exit door to the tarmac. Make sure you check with the agent at door before leaving the waiting room. Monks and his traveling companion receive priority boarding. Families with young children will have to fend for themselves.

Drinks are limited, but that is probably a great idea - if you wanted to you could try Myanmar red and white wine. I settled for Coke Light. A very pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Airline (MAI) canceled flight 4 days before. . .zero refund for major inconvenience
reviews.text: In March, 2018, I purchased a ticket on Vayama.com for a Myanmar Airways International (MAI) round-trip flight from Mandalay to Nyaung U for flight 8M4232 at 9:40 AM on June 21st. I did not purchase a one-way ticket. I paid for a round-trip ticket. The hotel I was staying at in Myanmar did not have good WiFi, and I did not receive an email dated June 17th. The email was a notification that my 9:40 AM flight on June 21st was canceled and rescheduled for 17:50 (5:50 PM). I left my hotel at around 7:10 AM for the hour-long drive to Mandalay Airport, and I arrived at the airport at 8:10 AM. At that time, I was notified that the MAI flight would not leave until 5:50 PM. Initially, the MAI representative told me that my only options were to wait at the airport until 5:50 PM (about a 10-hour wait), or I could pay $100 USD for a private taxi. After about 45 minutes, the airline representative told me I could take a shared bus for about $15 USD, but it would take 4 hours to get to Bagan. At that time, I asked if I could still use my ticket for the return trip from Bagan back to Mandalay, and I asked about a refund. She (the MAI representative) said I would need to contact the company that sold me the ticket (Vayama.com) to request a refund. I was assured everything would be fine. So, instead of arriving at 10:10 AM, I paid for the bus ticket and arrived in Bagan around 5:00 PM. Basically, I missed a full day of sightseeing in Bagan because MAI decided to cancel the 9:40 AM flight they
